items.title: How to Claim Your Cut of Apple’s $250 Million Siri Settlement
items.summary: Apple may pay out up to $95 for each eligible iPhone purchased by someone who felt misled about Siri’s release. You have until December 21 to submit a claim.
items.author: Reece Rogers

items.title: Rabbit Is Back, This Time With an AI Agent App
items.summary: Two years after trying to sidestep mobile apps with dedicated AI hardware, Rabbit is launching OS3, a cross-platform agent that lives on the screens you already use.
items.author: Julian Chokkattu

items.title: Viture’s Vonder Glasses Are Meant to Map Your Mind
items.summary: No cameras? No problem. Viture’s first display-free smart glasses have bone-conduction microphones to privately record your daily musings.
items.author: Boone Ashworth

items.title: AI Models Built From Rat Brains Just Got Closer to Reality
items.summary: The Biological Computing Company is bringing its AI tools to Amazon Web Services in a major boost for a once-fringe field that aims to marry nature with code.
items.author: Lauren Goode

items.title: I Built AI Clones of My Coworkers. Things Got Weird
items.summary: Brian Bot loved talking about improv, while Sophie Bot wouldn’t stop calling me “big dog.” Welcome to the future of work.
items.author: Kate Taylor

items.title: Patti Harrison Had Dreams of a Tech Utopia. Silicon Valley Smashed Them
items.summary: The comedian sat down with WIRED to talk about social media, AI, and getting laughs for impersonating Boston Dynamics’ robot dogs.
items.author: Katie Drummond

items.title: A New Tool Found Malware That’s Guided by an AI Hive Mind—No Humans in Sight
items.summary: Cisco Talos researchers created a new framework for identifying malware and hacking tools that rely on AI chatbots—and quickly discovered something unusual.
items.author: Lily Hay Newman

items.title: A New Chatbot Wants to Unlock the Secrets in Tattered Ancient Greek Records
items.summary: In the hope of uncovering new details about ancient life, researchers have developed a large language model that fills in the gaps in papyrus fragments.
items.author: Joel Khalili

items.title: How to Use AI With Your Privacy Intact
items.summary: Your conversations with AI chatbots are both highly personal and deeply vulnerable to surveillance. Here’s how you can protect yourself.
items.author: Andy Greenberg
